description.value: The Chase Chamber & Visitor Centre is the official Destination BC visitor information office for the Village of Chase, positioned just off the Trans-Canada Highway at the western gateway to the Shuswap. Staffed by certified Visitor Information Counsellors, it provides local maps, event listings, souvenirs, and Indigenous heritage context for the surrounding Secwepemcúl'ecw territory. Outside, ample parking accommodates large motorhomes, a small covered picnic area offers a rest spot, and an EV charging station sits on the exterior.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms 400 Shuswap Avenue, Chase as the address and chasechamber.com as the domain, matching OSM. The front page explicitly lists 'a public washroom' and 'free wi-fi for guests' as centre amenities, supporting those flags. Bike parking, water refill, showers, and most other cycling-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null; OSM carries no phone number but the contact page provides 250.679.8432.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; 250-679-8432 sourced from website contact page only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Website mentions an exterior EV charging station but does not specify e-bike compatibility; marked null rather than true.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An official Destination BC visitor information centre with confirmed public washrooms and free Wi-Fi on a major Trans-Canada corridor route; a practical and useful stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap.

wow_evidence: Staffed Destination BC VC at the Shuswap's western gateway; VC anchor band.
blurb: Chase's visitor centre off the Trans-Canada, gateway to the Shuswap.
